```{r}
# 94% of this data is 0s

rsv = read.csv("C:/Users/jacko/Documents/SeqBiomeML/RSV_1.csv")
# Be careful when doing this as the rownames are not 1:nrow(meta). It will have gaps (e.g. 1, 2, 4, 5, ...). This can cause issue in downstream analysis. Issue occurs in case_weight_vctr
true_meta = meta[meta$INCLUDE == c("YES"), ] # Only selects samples that are supposed to be included for analysis
rownames(rsv) = rsv$taxa
rsv = rsv[, -1]
rsv = as.data.frame(t(rsv))
rsv = rsv[rownames(rsv) %in% true_meta$SampleID, ]
```

```{r}
# Read DESCRIPTION file to extract Imports
description_file <- "C:/Users/jacko/Downloads/SeqBiomeML_latest/SeqBiomeML/DESCRIPTION"
description <- readLines(description_file)
pkg = description[13:28]
pkg = pkg[-15]

for (i in pkg) {
  x = sub(",", "", i)
  y = trimws(x)
  if (!requireNamespace(y, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(y)
  }
  library(y, character.only = T)
}
```

```{r}
outcome_type = "binary"
method = "rf"
set.seed(0)
true_meta = con_ath
rsv = comp_data
library(progressr)
y = true_meta[["ParticipantType"]]
set.seed(0)
rsv <- randomize_feature_order(rsv) %>% as.data.frame()
rsv <- preprocess_samples(dataset = rsv, scale_method = list("clr", "pseudo", 1))
training_inds = get_partition_indices(y, training_frac = 0.8)
train_data <- rsv[training_inds, ]
test_data <- rsv[-training_inds, ]
train_metadata <- true_meta[training_inds, ]
test_metadata <- true_meta[-training_inds, ]
pre = preprocess_features(train_data, test_data, outcome_colname = "ParticipantType", preprocess_methods = c("nzv"), corrFunList = list(corr_method = "spearman", corr_thresh = 0.95, group_neg_corr = TRUE))
train_data = pre[[1]]
test_data = pre[[2]]
filt_dataset <- filter_features_main(train_data = train_data, train_metadata = train_metadata, test_data = test_data, outcome_colname = "ParticipantType", filterFunList = list(test = "boruta_filter", n = 100, maxRuns = 100), outcome_type = outcome_type)
train_data = filt_dataset[[1]]
test_data = filt_dataset[[2]]
hyperparameters <- get_hyperparams_list(train_data, method)
tune_grid <- get_tuning_grid(hyperparameters, method)
perf_metric_function <- get_perf_metric_fn("binary")
perf_metric_name <- get_perf_metric_name("binary")
cross_val = define_cv_unnested(resamp_method = "cv",
        train_data = train_data,
        train_metadata = train_metadata,
        outcome_colname = "ParticipantType",
        hyperparams_list = hyperparameters,
        perf_metric_function = perf_metric_function,
        kfold = 5,
        seed = 0,
        groups = NULL,
        group_partitions = NULL,
        class_probs = TRUE)
trained_model_caret = train_model(
      train_data = train_data,
      train_metadata = train_metadata,
      outcome_colname = "ParticipantType",
      method = method,
      cv = cross_val,
      perf_metric_name = perf_metric_name,
      tune_grid = tune_grid)
performance_tbl <- get_performance_tbl(
      trained_model = trained_model_caret,
      test_data = test_data,
      test_metadata = test_metadata,
      outcome_colname = "ParticipantType",
      perf_metric_function = perf_metric_function,
      perf_metric_name = perf_metric_name,
      method = method,
      class_probs = T)
roc_out = plot_main(
      trained_model = trained_model_caret,
      test_data = test_data,
      test_metadata = test_metadata,
      outcome_colname = "ParticipantType",
      method = method,
      outcome_type = outcome_type)
feat_imp = feature_importance_main(
            feature_importance_method,
            trained_model = trained_model_caret,
            test_data = test_data,
            test_metadata = test_metadata,
            outcome_colname = "ParticipantType",
            perf_metric_function = perf_metric_function,
            perf_metric_name = perf_metric_name,
            class_probs = T,
            method = method,
            seed = 0,
            nperms = 100,
            threads = 1,
            performance_table = performance_tbl)
# pre
# test_data
# test_metadata
# cross_val
# trained_model_caret
performance_tbl
roc_out
feat_imp
```
